title: Remove adjacent duplicates
prompt: Implement `void removeAdjacentDuplicates(ArrayList<String> list)`: mutate the list so any run of equal neighboring elements collapses to one — ["a","a","b","b","b","c"] becomes ["a","b","c"]. Mind the shifting trap: walk BACKWARDS.

tests.name: runs collapsed
tests.hint: Backwards loop: remove i when list.get(i).equals(list.get(i - 1)).
